name: creative-studio-post
description: Runs the studio's post-production pipeline end to end: shot footage + audio files + the pre-prod release package (script, storyboard, concept breakdown) become a first cut, three BGM options, a synced audio track, on-demand B-roll variants and motion-graphic alphas, delivered as an FCPXML bundle the editor drops straight into Premiere Pro. Sibling to creative-studio-pipeline; extends the AgentC MCP with sequence, BGM, sync, B-roll and export tools.
